Consultoría por encargo: tu contexto par: On-demand consulting: your context for AI, digital engineering with BIM and GIS, custom tools, websites and experiences. Fernando Calle · ONTOS.
A partir de la experiencia y la aplicaci: From experience and the application of artificial intelligence, what used to be science fiction is now a reality.
Diseño aplicaciones y automatizaciones a: I design custom applications and automations to organise information, simplify work and bring new ideas to life.
Data, processes and knowledge, in order.
<em>Ontos</em>, del griego ὄντος: <span: Ontos, from the Greek ὄντος: “that which is”. Almost nobody has an information problem: what they have is an order problem. Data lives in folders, admin lives in your head and knowledge lives in each person's experience. ONTOS puts it in order and connects it to artificial intelligence, so that it works from your reality: in your daily life, in your project or in your company. A machine checks it. A person signs it.
Para personas y negocios con la informac: For people and businesses whose information is scattered across folders, inboxes and heads. We put what you know and have in order, and connect it to an AI that works from there, with sources you can check.
BIM, GIS y captura con dron para ingenie: BIM, GIS and drone capture for engineering firms and public procurement: information requirements, coordination and deliverable control. It starts with a free BIM readiness check.
Qué exige el Plan BIM a una ingeniería m: What Spain's BIM Plan demands of a mid-sized firm ▸
Para equipos que repiten operaciones o r: For teams that repeat operations or check documents by hand. Automations, checks and applications that turn a process or a collection into something people use: a PDF editor, a wardrobe app.
Webs para enseñar un trabajo o una obra,: Websites to show a body of work, which their owner updates without depending on anyone. And experiences to explore a brand or a place: 2D and 3D animation, games and navigable worlds.
Ropa colgada en baldas ordenadas por col: Clothes hung on shelves sorted by colour: whites, greys, blacks
Tu ropa, fichada y colgada en baldas: Your clothes, catalogued and hung on shelves
La misma casa en dos versiones: escanead: The same house in two versions: textured scan and simple geometry
De un vuelo a un modelo: From a flight to a model
Editor PDF con un documento de ejemplo d: PDF editor with a three-page sample document
Un editor de PDF que no saca tus documen: A PDF editor that never takes your documents off your computer
Portada de la web del pintor José María: Homepage of painter José María Casado's website
Una web que el cliente puede mantener: A website the client can maintain
Primero entendemos qué tienes y qué nece: First we understand what you have and what you need. Then we agree on what to build and what it costs, before we start.
Revisamos tu caso y te devolvemos, sin c: We review your case and send you back, free of charge, one page with what we would do, what we need from you and what is not worth doing.
Alcance, precio, plazo y cómo comprobare: Scope, price, timeline and how we will check that it works, in writing and before we start. You pay for the result, not for hours.
Una pieza concreta con tus datos reales,: A concrete piece with your real data, to review together and adjust.
Funcionando en tus equipos, con instrucc: Running on your own devices, with instructions and checks. If you like, we can also look after its maintenance.
